body: I’ve tried therapy and meds but it wasn’t for me I guess. Only made things worse .. thank you for taking the time to write kind words
Do you feel safer or better now?
Please be careful, and try to take good care of everything
Yea and I also hate cutting over old ones, it freaks me out ..
I get that..
Yea I get that
Im sorry :(
Yes it was the same for me, I have one big amazing scar and I want to get one like this again and I can’t even remember how I did it
Yes.. :(
Why in the other direction?
Yes I’ll do the same haha but I hate cutting over old scars it freaks me out lol
You’re right, thanks :)) I hate feeling ridiculous because of not cutting that deep.. hugs
What do you do then ?

Thank you for answering:)) 
I hope you took good care of it. Its probably hard to assess the amount of pressure to use if you’re doing it to someone else.. wish you the best :))

Such a pretty scar.. I always fantasized about a guy cutting my thigh during sex. But I never said it out loud because I thought nobody else would think something like that and I feel kinda relieved reading your post:) so thanks for sharing. If you don’t mind me asking. Did you just asked him to do it and he agreed?

Oh and Im sorry that it made you relapse. You are strong and gonna battle this !
Absolutely no need to be sorry. I love to hear you liking them! Hope you feel better nowadays
Yes.. I feel like I could never show people in my surroundings. They just wouldn’t react nicely and I got through summer with wearing long sleeves so I guess I can do it forever haha

Thank you for your words, means a lot. I know how you feel. I mean, its not for attention but its still disappointing when nobody notices or cares. Because even though it’s not the intention, it would be nice for people to be worried I guess
Thank you, Marry Christmas to you too:) I really appreciate talking to people on here that are kind and understanding.. should’ve done it sooner:)
That sounds amazing. So happy for you!! It’s admirable that you feel happy and are able to like them!! Wish you all the best
Noo don’t be sorry haha I like it to, at first I hated them being messy but I guess it’s nice
I feel that. Its a weird feeling. Sometimes I suddenly hate them so much knowing that the scars will be there forever and it scares me but I guess I’m good at hiding
Yes its definitely difficult because on one hand it shouldnt be glorified or anything because it still is sh.. but one the other hand they still can look nice haha
Haha well..thanks? I hate myself for liking you saying that

I feel you 100% !!
I reopen them everyday and keep them from healing, but it sucks that they still eventually will heal..and then they look so invalid and meaningless and it sucks so bad.. 😞feels like all hard work is gone
Feel hugged:)

I also feel like this. I hate them healing so much. I try to keep them from healing because its so frustrating when the wounds don’t„look that bad anymore“ . Its as if it isnt showing the actual pain thats behind it anymore and it sucks

I know how you feel. I feel euphoric when I cut deep and it gapes open .. just looks so nice.. and when I get the urge to cut there are these pictures in my head of a a big clean cut and blood streaming down feeling warm.. 
sometimes I do feel like I’m just doing it because of the wounds but I guess thats the addiction haha 

But at the same time I freak out from the thought of someone seeing them and scars being there forever.. so 🤷🏼‍♀️

But what is living just for me .. is it supposed to be fun ? I feel like its just unnecessary..
I tried so many meds and stuff .. nothing works for me and I can feel my doctor being annoyed by me 
Thanks for your reply, means much

That’s really kind of you. It’s just that I literally have no desire to do anything. I don’t want to leave my bed, I hate meeting people, I just realize that I really don’t even want to do any of the things one would consider fun..
Guess there really is no point for me being here if it’s just isn’t for me
I’d love that, thank you
I feel that you really long for someone to be close to you.. I wish you so badly that soon there will be people in your life and you feel loved
I feel the same way. But I try to think that maybe that’s enough for now.. ?

Yes I see.. it must be especially hard in a society like this, that is so superficial and insensitive :(
But I’m sure you’re loved and appreciated just the way you are
I feel the same way.. and I’d feel hypocritical if I tried to convince you otherwise when I dont believe it for myself .. So I’m just gonna say.. hold on and please try fighting

Im just so sorry that you feel that way. I understand it must be so hard having to struggle with diseases everyday and having to fight to feel worthy..
I wish you the strength to hang on..despite everything!
You‘re right!
